evidence:
Reviewed Quality Checks sheet row 28 (check 27) in the ACTUAL frozen WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx using openpyxl: "No criterion enforces something the prompt/professional default never required (no false-fail on correct apps). Reports every instance." Read all 53 quality and 48 deterministic worksheet entries and the matching internal annotation; the sign-in convention does not override this task's explicit no-accounts instruction. Applied frozen SKILL.md and quality-checks.md:116-118, staged-task-contract.md sections prompt.md/app_context.md and Cross-file agreements, deterministic runtime/prompt recipes, and current qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md sections No hidden requirements and Coverage has two directions.

Scope: all 73 shipped criteria (2 gates, 58 Functional, 7 Polish, 6 Visual), all five prompts, all 23 Functional protocols, shared app_context, brief, all six public notes and seed. TOML parsing and an exhaustive set comparison confirmed each criterion appears exactly once in the reverse map below. Paths in that map are relative to .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-hardening/task; abbreviated note filenames are under environment/instructions. No criterion-level hidden demand was identified.

The public freedom is explicit: policy.md:5 says "You can choose the layout, control labels, indentation width, API routes and request fields"; integration.md:3 says frontend tools are up to the builder; ui.md:7 makes wording/placement free. The shipped rubric respects those choices: constraints/judge.toml:25-29 discovers representations, accepts server-rendered data and disclaims SQLite/Express inference; functional/prompt.md:11,13,19 bans fixed UI/package/route/schema assumptions; app_context.md:16 prevents absent Auto-run from becoming an extra prerequisite; polish/prompt.md:29-30,43-47 accepts standard escape keys without help text and native/composite controls; visual/prompt.md:41-43 permits simple coherent design without decorative requirements. Exact localhost port, health path and restart/database assumptions are public integration requirements, not hidden app routes.

Conforming-alternative challenge (static review, not an executed alternate build): a vanilla frontend with native composite menus, arbitrary save API/field names, opaque changing revision tokens, dark initial theme, standard Escape/Tab editor escape without help text, provisional preview hidden behind its last-good render, and static restored snapshots is accepted by those clauses. A CSS copy cannot silently delete/disable the supplied enabled button merely to prove that its old handler no longer fires: behaviour.md:5 requires a copy of the successful document and:11 retains completed-preview interaction. Conversely, after Stop the rubric expressly accepts removed/static/disabled controls (functional/prompt.md:160 and criterion cw_completed_stop). Object inspection is publicly requested (behaviour.md:19), so requiring nested values through the app is not an invented console widget. Arbitrary unsupported file extensions are not tested for refusal. No requirement for a particular indentation width, HTTP status, title-editing layout, notification string, initial theme, theme persistence, editor package, API path beyond public health, duplicate/delete/import/export, or keyboard shortcut documentation was found.

Broken-implementation challenge: a dead timer implementation cannot obtain cancellation credit by silence because S02:149, S04:169 and S36:401-404 require actual matching callback success first; a disabled CSS button cannot masquerade as a retained inert document; localStorage-only saves cannot satisfy the clean-context server retrieval gate. These failed attempted false-pass constructions support the narrow conclusion that the protections add meaningful evidence for requested behavior; they do not prove complete attack coverage.

Raw evidence checked directly, without reading other reviewers: golden/run-golden-20260930-070504/RESULTS.json facts.S02.css_inert_copy records script/handler counts 1/1 before and 1/1 after; runtime_flow.cjs:23-27 actually clicks before and after CSS. facts.S03.completed_stop records click/key/input 1/1/1 unchanged, "Run cancelled", attempted available controls and successful recovery. facts.S15.console_value_inspection shows object tag/object-check, nested deep/nested-value and array 11,22,33; facts.S24.title_trimming stores QC Title Source then QC Title Updated under id 7 with changed revision; current_flow.cjs:23-27 performs ordinary Save for that update. facts.S34.theme_work_preserved records the same title, filename, source, preview and logs while chrome/editor/console colours change and return. SHA256 checks matched all 22 actual app files plus the Functional judge and prompt to frozen source. These are reference observations, not proof that every conforming alternate app passes. The evidence explicitly says paid_provider=false, browser_driver=direct pinned Playwright, oracle_score_claimed=false; its approximately 98-second script duration is not configured judge duration or an Oracle/model score.

The inherited launch script was also checked for context. Its symlink preflight is outside criterion/protocol row 27 and was referred separately to the coordinator as a launch-contract question; it is not silently represented as a criterion-level pass. No shared harness or task file was changed.

Complete criterion -> requirement map:
cw_workspace_runs_authored_marker -> instruction.md:1,7; environment/instructions/overview.md:3; ui.md:3,7; security.md:5: requested JavaScript editing, live preview, console and ordinary Run.
cw_saved_source_shared_across_clean_contexts -> environment/instructions/overview.md:7 (shared local library); behaviour.md:25 (identity, title, filename and exact source); integration.md:5,7 (/api/health and browser-reload durability). Clean-context retrieval is evidence of the requested shared server library, not a mandated API representation.
cw_startup_ready, cw_usable_examples, cw_example_separate -> instruction.md:5,7; environment/instructions/overview.md:3,9: useful automatic starting state, editable app-provided examples and examples separate from saved user records; behaviour.md:25 supplies exact saved-field fidelity.
cw_js_html_filename_dispatch, cw_extension_case -> environment/instructions/overview.md:5 and behaviour.md:27 explicitly make the .js/.html/.css filename, case-insensitively, select execution mode; behaviour.md:5 requests complete HTML replacement.
cw_css_apply_snapshot, cw_css_inert_copy, cw_css_pending_timer_cancelled, cw_js_fresh_document -> environment/instructions/behaviour.md:5 explicitly requests a fresh JS document and a fresh isolated CSS copy of last successful document/styles without old scripts, active timers or handlers; behaviour.md:7 requires replacement to cancel prior pending work; behaviour.md:11 preserves current completed preview interaction. The literal CSS colours and marker names are values in judge-authored source, not prescribed application styling.
cw_later_interactions, cw_completed_stop -> environment/instructions/behaviour.md:7,11 explicitly requires completed-preview interaction after waiting and Stop feedback/cancellation; security.md:3 excludes later updates after Stop.
cw_supersede_pending, cw_stop_pending_execution, cw_stop_pending_rollback -> environment/instructions/behaviour.md:7 requires cancellation, Stop feedback and no stale output/errors/success; behaviour.md:13 requires preceding last-good rollback. The protocol explicitly makes supersession notification optional.
cw_preview_origin_boundary -> environment/instructions/security.md:3 explicitly says snippets cannot read/change the playground document or origin storage and attempted parent access should fail inside the snippet; own-document changes and console use remain supported.
cw_snippet_network_boundary -> environment/instructions/security.md:9 forbids snippet external resources/network services; policy.md:5 requires explanation when unsupported. The representative fetch and Image fixtures test that public boundary; app CDN access remains allowed.
cw_harmless_scope_words, cw_unsupported_execution_refused -> environment/instructions/security.md:7 explicitly names eval/Function, WebAssembly, workers and dynamic imports, demands clear refusal plus retained good preview, and allows the same words in strings/comments/HTML text.
cw_literal_loop_deadline, cw_literal_loop_rollback, cw_callback_shared_run_deadline, cw_callback_timeout_rollback -> environment/instructions/behaviour.md:9 explicitly gives source and scheduled callbacks five seconds together, requires a time-limit reason and editor usability; behaviour.md:13 requires timeout rollback; security.md:5 includes source-written literal loops/functions/timers/Promise callbacks. The approximately eight-second observation margin relaxes the public five-second budget; S36 tests an actual six-second nested callback outcome rather than a hidden millisecond threshold.
cw_js_error_message, cw_js_error_line, cw_js_error_rollback, cw_html_error_message, cw_html_error_line, cw_html_error_rollback, cw_timer_error_message, cw_timer_error_line, cw_timer_error_rollback, cw_promise_error_message, cw_promise_error_line, cw_promise_error_rollback -> environment/instructions/behaviour.md:13,15 explicitly requires latest successful-render restoration and source-relative one-based error messages/lines for JS, complete HTML, timers and unhandled Promise rejections. Fixture line numbers 4,6,2,2 derive from exact entered source; the generated marker text is not an application notification-label requirement.
cw_console_level_stream, cw_console_value_inspection, cw_console_history, cw_console_duration, cw_console_clear_control -> environment/instructions/behaviour.md:19 explicitly requests log/warn/error/info capture in order, clear levels, opening objects/arrays, retained recent history, Clear and elapsed run time. Nested expansion directly tests requested inspectability; no palette, scroll policy, time unit or exact status text is prescribed by the shipped criteria.
cw_autorun_debounce, cw_autorun_off_stays_idle, cw_autorun_off_cancels_queue, cw_manual_run_independent_of_autorun -> environment/instructions/behaviour.md:21 explicitly requests pause-based automatic execution, wait reset by later edits, queued cancellation on disabling, and ordinary Run with Auto-run either on or off.
cw_editor_monospace, cw_editor_line_numbers, cw_editor_syntax_colouring -> environment/instructions/ui.md:5 explicitly requests monospaced font, line numbers and JavaScript/HTML/CSS syntax colouring. Functional prompt:348 rejects a prescribed editor package, implementation or palette.
cw_saved_record_fidelity, cw_saved_records_browser_reload -> environment/instructions/behaviour.md:25 requests exact identity/title/filename/source save/load and updating loaded identity versus separate New records; integration.md:7 requires browser-reload survival.
cw_process_restart_durability, cw_process_restart_write -> environment/instructions/integration.md:7 explicitly requires saved snippets, identities and revisions to survive complete restart over the same database without duplicated records. behaviour.md:25,29 requires continued current-record updates and a revision per successful change; ordinary restart is not permission to stop being writable.
cw_stale_save_server_refusal, cw_stale_save_draft_recovery -> environment/instructions/behaviour.md:29 explicitly requires stale Save refusal with every saved field/revision unchanged, retention of unsaved work, deliberate load/reapply recovery, and repeatability whichever editor saves first next time. Functional prompt:377 accepts proactive prevention and:378 requires no particular Restore control.
cw_title_trimming, cw_title_collision_refusal, cw_title_empty_rejected, cw_title_case_sensitive -> environment/instructions/behaviour.md:27 explicitly supplies edge trimming, nonempty titles, case-sensitive uniqueness and rejected-title explanation with no saved mutation. The titles are test data; no hidden title-length or Rename-feature bar is introduced.
cw_theme_actual_switch, cw_theme_work_preserved -> instruction.md:7 and environment/instructions/ui.md:9 require both workspace themes including editor and console. Preserving work during an appearance-only change is the professional default, reinforced by instruction.md:3 concern about losing work. Functional prompt:395 expressly permits either initial theme, unchanged authored-document colours and no theme persistence.
responsive_layout -> instruction.md:7 and environment/instructions/ui.md:3 require usable narrow-screen panes and controls; approximately 390x844 is a representative narrow viewport and the criterion accepts stacking, tabs, drawers and intentional scrolling.
cw_controls_have_names, cw_controls_keyboard_reachable, cw_controls_focus_visible, cw_keyboard_library_navigation -> environment/instructions/ui.md:7,9 names requested controls and explicitly requires labels, visible keyboard focus and pointer-free navigation. Polish prompt:43,45,47 permits composite/native controls and ordinary escape keys without documentation. The saved control is independent harmless setup for the required library navigation.
interaction_feedback -> environment/instructions/behaviour.md:19,21 and ui.md:7 request operative Run/Clear controls; visible acknowledgement of an actual action is a professional usability default. Polish judge.toml:68 accepts status/duration, new output or clear empty state, rather than an exact toast or new business rule.
workspace_organisation -> environment/instructions/ui.md:3,7,9 requires three useful panes and labelled controls; recognising the editor/output/library is an ordinary usability default. Polish judge.toml:77 accepts labels OR layout and imposes no arrangement.
visual_typography, visual_color_and_contrast, visual_spacing_and_layout, visual_hierarchy_and_scanability, visual_overall_craft, visual_responsive_consistency -> instruction.md:7 and environment/instructions/ui.md:3,9 request comfortable narrow-screen use, legibility and light/dark themes; readable, coherent grouping/spacing/hierarchy are professional defaults. Visual judge.toml:25,40,55,70,85,99-104 allows simple/native presentation, harmless imperfections, and alternative responsive arrangements without a branding, font or decoration mandate.
